dialogues.jp: さらさらのシーツが気持ちいい……。

dialogues.en: Who is it......? This isn't a good time......
dialogues.text: Who is it......? This isn't a good time......

dialogues.jp: 暫く放っておいてほしい……。
dialogues.en: I want to be left alone for a while.......
dialogues.text: I want to be left alone for a while.......

dialogues.jp: （だ――っ！　勝手に入って来いよ）

いつものようにニッコリと微笑んで、萌先輩が
入ってくる。
dialogues.en: Moe came in smiling just as usual.
dialogues.text: Moe came in smiling just as usual.

dialogues.jp:
萌先輩が部屋に入ってくる間に、ベッドの上で
軽く身体を伸ばす。
dialogues.en:
I stretched my body under the blanket while she was coming
into the room.
dialogues.text:
I stretched my body under the blanket while she was coming
into the room.

dialogues.jp:
「先輩、今度からはすぐに入ってきてくれて構
　いませんよ」
dialogues.en: "Moe-sempai, you can just come into my room from now on."
dialogues.text: "Moe-sempai, you can just come into my room from now on."

dialogues.jp: その方がこっちも楽だし。
dialogues.en: That saves time for me too.
dialogues.text: That saves time for me too.

dialogues.jp: 荷物を置いて、ベッドの脇にある丸イスに座る。
dialogues.en: She put her bag down and sat on the chair beside the bed.
dialogues.text: She put her bag down and sat on the chair beside the bed.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「あの……明日からは、妹さんの代わりに私が
　朝倉くんのお世話をしますね」
dialogues.en:
"Ummm...... I'll take care of you instead of your sister
from tomorrow on."
dialogues.text:
"Ummm...... I'll take care of you instead of your sister
from tomorrow on."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「眞子ちゃんに連絡があって、しばらく何かの
　準備をしなければならないそうなので、お願
　いします、ということだそうです」
dialogues.en:
"Your sister called Mako, and told her that she needs to
take care of something else for a while."
dialogues.text:
"Your sister called Mako, and told her that she needs to
take care of something else for a while."

dialogues.jp:
なんだかよく分かったような、分からないよう
な説明だが、要は音夢は入学の準備でしばらく
来れない、と。
dialogues.en:
Her explanation was kind of vague, but I understand that
Nemu will be busy for a while with preparation for her new
school.
dialogues.text:
Her explanation was kind of vague, but I understand that
Nemu will be busy for a while with preparation for her new
school.

dialogues.jp:
で、音夢が眞子に電話をして萌先輩に俺の世話
を頼んだと――まあ、こんなところだろう。
dialogues.en:
I assume that's why she called Mako to ask Moe-sempai to
take care of me......
dialogues.text:
I assume that's why she called Mako to ask Moe-sempai to
take care of me......

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「じゃあ、洗濯物はお預かりしますね」
萌先輩が音夢の置いていった袋を確認する。
dialogues.en: Moe-sempai checked the bag that Nemu left here.
dialogues.text: Moe-sempai checked the bag that Nemu left here.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「朝倉くん、なにかしてほしいことはありませ
　んか？」
dialogues.en: "Is there anything you'd like me to do for you?"
dialogues.text: "Is there anything you'd like me to do for you?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「そうですか……では、おトイレとかは大丈夫
　ですか？」
dialogues.en: "Okay...... How about the restroom? Do you need to go?"
dialogues.text: "Okay...... How about the restroom? Do you need to go?"

dialogues.jp:
俺は激しく首を振ると、とりあえず、花瓶の水
を替えてくれるようお願いする。
dialogues.en: As she smiled softly, my nightmare came back into my mind.
dialogues.text: As she smiled softly, my nightmare came back into my mind.

dialogues.jp:
萌先輩が来てくれた。音夢は入学の準備で忙し
く、眞子を通して、俺の世話を萌先輩に頼んだ
らしかった。
dialogues.en:
Moe-sempai came to visit me. Nemu's busy preparing for the
new school, so she asked Moe-sempai to take care of me
instead.
dialogues.text:
Moe-sempai came to visit me. Nemu's busy preparing for the
new school, so she asked Moe-sempai to take care of me
instead.
